include_directories(${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include/reactos/libs/fmifs)

# format.com is all Rust (format-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/format-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# format.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/format-rust/src/format/format.rs)
add_cargo_module(format format-cargo format.com
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE format-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS xdk psdk)
